headline: Revenue up 28%, but EPS missed on AI spend
chart_note: 52-week range: $520.26 - $796.25. Currently $649.92, about 18% below its 52-week high.
why_today: Q2 2026 revenue reached $60.8B, up 28% YoY on strong ad growth. But EPS of $6.18 missed the $7.22 estimate as total costs jumped 55%, compressing operating margin to 31% from 43% a year ago. Full-year capex guidance was raised to $130-145B.
pro_1: Ad revenue growth still accelerating (28% YoY), and PEG of 0.91 suggests the growth isn't fully priced in
pro_2: 62 analysts rate it Strong Buy, average price target of $754 implies roughly 17% upside
con_1: Operating margin compressed sharply (43% to 31%) as AI infrastructure spending ramps
con_2: Capex guidance keeps climbing ($130-145B for FY26), raising the bar for AI spend to pay off
